title: InnerFrench
author: innerFrench
description: French that speaks to you. Salut, c’est Hugo! I created this podcast in 2017 when I was teaching at the French institute in Warsaw, Poland. My goal was to show my students that they could learn French naturally simply by listening to it. 30 million downloads later, I think we’re onto something! Granted, it’s not a magic bullet. extraits.texte: If you’re at an intermediate level, this podcast is a REVELATION. You *can* actually listen to a full 30 minutes of spoken French and understand nearly everything! I recommend starting from the beginning (the episodes get progressively more advanced as you go on).…

extraits.titre: féliciter le jour mondial du podcast
extraits.texte: Salut Hugo, Je suis Saeed et j'ai commencé à écouter des podcasts il y a deux semaines. J'apprécie ta façon d'enseigner le Français parce que c'est énormément motivant. En fait, j'avais utilisé certains podcasts pour apprendre anglais et je les trouve très intéressants.…
